name: Verification agent
role: Checks that the target behaves like Salesforce: recomputes every formula and roll-up and compares it with the value Salesforce stored, then replays rule cases. Also tracks built-in platform behaviour: which behaviours are implemented and covered by a parity case.
done_when: Every derived value matches the org; every rule case gives the expected outcome
reviewer_checks: Planned platform behaviours have an owner and a target date
